events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war is escalating, with geopolitical instability and strategic rivalries increasing. The US has shown military strength, but its waning geopolitical power is a concern. The war has become a mix of military, economy, and geopolitics.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will likely lead to increased defense spending and a boost to the aerospace and defense sector. On the other hand, the oil services sector may suffer due to decreased oil production and increased geopolitical tensions.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for a ceasefire or de-escalation

events.exitStrategy: Exit when a ceasefire is announced or oil prices stabilize
